sources.description: The serious health predicament facing Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts—Hurts has been diagnosed with a deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and blood clots in his lungs—could spiral into a legal controversy, but don’t expect it to wind up in court.
